toxicMaterial.name: Chironex fleckeri venom
toxicMaterial.description: A cnidarian venom delivered through nematocyst discharge on tentacle contact. This record avoids assigning a single compound as the complete cause of contact effects.
toxicMaterial.ecologicalRoleSummary: Supports prey capture and defense in a marine cnidarian.

components.summary: Venom is delivered through specialized contact-triggered nematocysts.
